NDT training in Galveston: how it works for Galveston employers and technicians

Short answer: Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT SNT-TC-1A NDT training for Galveston-area employers and technicians at Level I, II and III in UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET. Theory runs live online or in arranged classroom sessions; practical training runs onsite at your facility under ASNT Level III oversight. Certification is issued by your employer under its written practice. There is no Atlantis training centre on the island or in Texas City. Quotes are on request.

Galveston County is refinery, petrochemical and maritime country squeezed onto a barrier island and the bay shore. Texas City's refinery and chemical complex, the island's port and ship-repair activity, the pipelines and terminals that link the bay to the Houston Ship Channel, and the storage tanks that sit behind every one of them together create steady inspection demand. Much of it arrives in bursts: a turnaround at a Texas City unit, a rig or vessel in for repair on Pelican Island, a post-storm inspection campaign after a hurricane season.

That shape of demand means Galveston-area employers need technicians who can be trained, examined and certified quickly and properly before a peak, and who can fit continuing training around it. Atlantis trains to ASNT SNT-TC-1A. The API and CWI schemes that local owners also ask for are separate and are not offered by Atlantis; this page explains how they fit together. Request a Galveston training quote with methods, levels and headcount.

ASNT Level I, II and III courses available in Galveston

All courses are available as live online theory plus onsite practical at the employer's facility, with course content reviewed by an ASNT Level III against the SNT-TC-1A body of knowledge.

MethodLevelsWhat Galveston employers use it forPrerequisite
Ultrasonic Testing (UT)I, II, III prepCorrosion and thickness surveys on process piping, vessels and tank shells; weld inspection; hull plate gauging in ship repairNone for Level I; Level I plus documented experience for Level II
Phased Array UT (PAUT)II, III prepEncoded weld inspection on new piping and vessels; corrosion mapping on process equipment during turnaroundsUT Level II recommended
Time-of-Flight Diffraction (TOFD)II, III prepThick-section weld sizing on pressure vessels and heavy-wall piping; often combined with PAUTUT Level II recommended
Radiographic Testing (RT)I, II, III prepPiping weld radiography, profile RT for corrosion under insulation, digital RT on small-bore linesTexas DSHS radiographer trainee/certification requirements for source work
Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)I, II, III prepWet fluorescent MT for cracking in vessels and welds; lifting gear; marine structural weldsNone for Level I
Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)I, II, III prepStainless and alloy welds, non-magnetic components, valve and pump partsNone for Level I
Visual Testing (VT)I, II, III prepExternal inspection of piping, tanks and structures; weld visual; marine and dock structuresNone for Level I
Eddy Current Testing (ET)I, II, III prepHeat-exchanger tube inspection during turnarounds; coating thickness; surface cracks on conductive partsNone for Level I

In practice, a Galveston Bay career usually starts with UT thickness, VT and MT/PT, then moves into RT or weld UT, and then into PAUT, TOFD or tube ET, which are the advanced methods that turnaround contractors struggle to staff. Level III candidates can prepare through ASNT Level III training.

SNT-TC-1A certification path in Galveston, step by step

Refinery and chemical plant owners in Galveston County typically require contractors' NDT personnel to hold SNT-TC-1A certification (or equivalent under the owner's specification) at a stated level for each method. Here is how that certification is built.

  1. The employer's written practice. It sets training and experience hours, examination content and passing grades, vision requirements, who administers examinations and how often technicians recertify. See written practice development.
  2. Classroom training hours for each method and level. The recommended minimums are in the training requirements matrix; owners' specifications and your written practice can require more.
  3. On-the-job experience, documented and supervised, on real plant, pipeline, tank or marine work.
  4. General examination on method theory.
  5. Specific examination on your procedures, equipment and the codes you apply, such as ASME Section V techniques and ASME B31.3 acceptance criteria.
  6. Practical examination on real specimens, administered and graded under a Level III.
  7. Vision examination for near vision and colour contrast at the written practice's interval.
  8. Employer certification once the record is complete.
  9. Recertification at the interval specified, by examination or evidence of continued satisfactory performance.

Full detail: SNT-TC-1A training and certification.

Online, live-virtual or onsite NDT training for Galveston crews

Atlantis has no physical training centre in Galveston, Texas City or League City. The model is built around employers.

  • Live online theory so technicians can complete classroom hours without being pulled off a unit or a vessel for days. See NDT training online.
  • Onsite practical at your facility: your shop, yard or plant training area, your instruments and specimens representative of your work, such as corroded pipe sections, vessel weld samples or hull plate.
  • Classroom cohorts arranged at your site or an agreed venue when a group forms.
  • Corporate programmes covering training, examinations and Level III services; see corporate NDT training.

Turnaround season drives everything around the bay. Plants commonly schedule major turnarounds in spring and autumn, and hurricane season (June to November) can pull crews into post-storm inspections at short notice. We schedule theory before your peaks and put onsite practical and examinations in the gaps, so newly qualified technicians are ready when the work starts rather than after. Ask about pre-turnaround training for your Galveston crew; cohort and onsite quotes are normally returned within one business day.

Where NDT technicians work in Galveston

  • Texas City refining. Marathon Petroleum's Galveston Bay refinery and Valero's Texas City refinery run process units, piping, pressure vessels, heaters, exchangers and tank farms that need continuous inspection, with peaks at turnarounds. Typical codes: API 510, 570 and 653 for in-service inspection programmes, ASME Section VIII and B31.3 for repairs and alterations, ASME Section V for NDE techniques.
  • Petrochemicals. Chemical plants in the Texas City industrial area bring similar piping, vessel and exchanger inspection, with more stainless and alloy material and therefore more PT and ET.
  • Storage terminals and tanks. Bulk liquid terminals around the bay depend on tank floor, shell and nozzle inspection under API 653, with UT, MT, VT and floor scanning.
  • Ship repair and offshore. Pelican Island and the Galveston channel host ship-repair and offshore rig repair activity, generating hull gauging (UT), structural weld inspection (MT, UT, VT) and repair weld RT. Marine work often references classification-society rules and AWS D1.1 or D3.6.
  • Port and cruise infrastructure. The Port of Galveston's docks, cruise terminals and cargo facilities bring steel structure, piling and crane inspection.
  • Pipelines. Product and gas lines running around the bay and toward the Ship Channel mean API 1104 weld inspection on construction and UT/RT on integrity digs.
  • Bridges and causeway. The I-45 causeway and bay-area bridges operate in one of the most corrosive environments in Texas, making coatings, corrosion and weld inspection a recurring need.

Radiography licensing in Texas. Texas is an NRC Agreement State. The Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) Radiation Control Program licenses industrial radiography under 25 TAC §289.255 and certifies industrial radiographers. New radiographers begin as trainees with a DSHS trainee status card, complete the required radiation safety course and supervised on-the-job training with an authorised radiographer trainer, and then qualify for certification. This is separate from, and in addition to, SNT-TC-1A RT certification by the employer. Atlantis RT method training covers technique and interpretation; radiation safety falls under your licence and DSHS rules. Check current DSHS requirements.

What local owners also ask for. Many owners and marine clients around Galveston also ask for API 510, 570 or 653 authorised inspectors, AWS CWI weld inspectors, and in some offshore work CSWIP. These are separate schemes; Atlantis does not train or certify for them. NDT technicians who hold solid SNT-TC-1A Level II certifications are what those inspection programmes rely on to carry out the actual examinations.

For pay expectations, see the NDT salary guide.

Level III services and written practices for Galveston NDT companies

Plant owners around Galveston Bay audit their NDT contractors: written practices, procedures, certification files, vision records and examination records. A contractor that cannot produce those cleanly can lose access to a site. Atlantis supports Galveston-area NDT companies with:

  • SNT-TC-1A written practice development and review, including adding advanced methods such as PAUT, TOFD and tube ET. See written practice development.
  • Procedure writing aligned to the codes and owner specifications you work to.
  • Examination administration for general, specific and practical exams, timed ahead of turnaround mobilisations.
  • Audit preparation against owner prequalification and site audits.

Background: SNT-TC-1A training and certification. Book a Level III consultation for your Galveston company.

Practise before the practical exam

The Practical NDT 3D simulator lets trainees practise 12 methods in 5 environments: an NDT lab, a welding workshop, an aircraft hangar, an oil and gas site and a storage tank. The oil and gas site and storage tank scenes are the closest match to Galveston Bay work. It helps with set-up, scanning coverage and indication recognition before hands-on time. It is practice only and does not replace training hours, supervised experience or the practical examination on real specimens.

Your instructor

Training is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III and founder of Atlantis NDT. He builds the course content, oversees practical sessions and examinations, and works with employers on written practices and Level III services. See all NDT training programmes.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Galveston

How do I get NDT certified in Galveston?

Under SNT-TC-1A your employer certifies you after you complete training hours, documented on-the-job experience, general, specific and practical examinations under a Level III, and a vision test. Atlantis provides training, practical preparation and, for employers, written practices and exams.

Can I take NDT training online in Texas?

Yes, for the classroom hours through live online sessions. Practical training and the practical exam must be done hands-on, which Atlantis delivers onsite at your employer's facility. See NDT training online.

How long does UT Level 2 training take?

It is set by the employer's written practice. SNT-TC-1A recommends minimum training and experience hours by level; experience usually takes longest. See the training requirements matrix.

Do I need a license for radiography in Texas?

Yes. Industrial radiography in Texas is licensed and radiographers are certified by DSHS under 25 TAC §289.255, starting with a trainee status card. That is in addition to the employer's SNT-TC-1A RT certification.

What does NDT training cost in Galveston?

Quote on request. It depends on methods, levels, headcount, whether practical work runs onsite, and any written practice or exam services. Cohort and onsite quotes are normally returned within one business day. Request a Galveston quote.

Is ASNT certification recognised by Galveston employers?

Yes. SNT-TC-1A is the standard framework for NDT personnel at refineries, chemical plants, terminals and inspection contractors around Galveston Bay. Owners may add their own specifications on top.

Does Atlantis offer API 510, 570 or 653 training?

No. Atlantis trains NDT methods under SNT-TC-1A only. API inspector certifications and AWS CWI are separate schemes that some local owners also require.

Which NDT methods are most useful for turnaround work?

UT thickness and weld UT, PAUT corrosion mapping, RT, MT, PT, VT and heat-exchanger tube ET. Advanced methods are the hardest to staff at short notice.

Can you train our crew before a turnaround?

Yes. Theory runs live online ahead of time, with onsite practical and examinations scheduled so technicians are certified before mobilisation.

Can Atlantis act as our outside Level III?

Yes, including written practices, procedures, examinations and audit preparation. See written practice development.

Is there a simulator to practise on?

Yes, Practical NDT, including oil and gas site and storage tank scenes. Practice only.

Where can I find practice questions?

See UT Level 2 practice questions.
